tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the hand-checked list of AI tools by words, by category, or both. Sponsored tools (at most 3 per category, taking turns each day) come at the top of a category and are marked.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: One tool by its slug (from search_tools): website, description, pricing page, category and whether it is sponsored.

tools.name: list_upcoming
tools.description: AI tools that are not out yet and launch on a set day (launchAt, UTC), soonest first. Each joins the list on its launch day.

tools.name: list_deals
tools.description: Black Friday 2026 deals on AI tools, each one opened and checked by a person: the deal, its price, code and end time, and what a year costs against paying yearly on a normal day. Live and coming deals, the soonest ending first. Paid top spots are marked sponsored.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The categories of the list, with how many tools each has.

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: What it costs to list an AI tool, and the ways to pay (card on Stripe, or USDC with x402).

tools.name: submit_listing
tools.description: Submit an AI tool for the list. Free listings wait for review. For fasttrack and featured you get checkoutUrl: give it to the person, who pays on Stripe.

tools.name: check_listing
tools.description: The status of a listing from submit_listing. Once it is live, also its badge and share links and the last 30 days of numbers: page views, clicks to the site, times AI agents got it, and sites showing its badge.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_listing · Public sink: submit_listing, check_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_listing · Public sink: submit_listing, check_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
